summary: Nova Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its third-quarter 2026 earnings date. The Israeli foreign private issuer will report results before Nasdaq opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026, with a conference call at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time hosted by President and CEO Gaby Waisman and CFO Guy Kizner. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanic is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary earnings-scheduling notice and presents no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle; watch only for Q3 results and guidance.
